name: VEYRO API Hub
purpose: Provider registry used by the AI Orchestrator to select APIs for generated apps/games.
selection_rules: Never expose provider secrets in generated APK/AAB.
Route authenticated providers through the VEYRO backend.
Store provider terms, auth mode, quotas and last_verified_at.
Run a health check before allowing an integration into a build.
Mark uncertain commercial/licensing status as CONDITIONAL or HOLD.
